title: Volume and Capacity
summary: Unit cubes, layers and litres: the volume of cuboids, cubes and cylinders.

ib.note: Volume and capacity are MYP 3 Measurement

objectives: I can find the volume of cuboids, cubes and cylinders.
I can convert between cm³, m³ and litres.
